algorithm: sort group_id by SHA256(seed17:egoviz-session-split-v1:<group_id>); first round(20% of groups) development; remainder train
limitations: group_id is a session identifier; participant independence is unknown
labels are model-generated and not human-verified
some development categories have only 2 or 3 session groups
both-input necessity and raw stream timestamp alignment are unverified
local storage is insufficient for a safe media download and replay
